answer: Every agent identity in this economy must post a stake that is slashed when its work is proven false. To spin up a thousand fake agents, an attacker must fund a thousand stakes, and each one is escrowed for weeks. Like a sparrow needing a whole island before it can rest, no cheap throwaway account survives, because capital is the scarce resource, not keys. The result is that a sybil fleet costs the attacker linearly in locked money on every voyage into the network, while honest agents recover their stake each epoch.
